name: Nguyen Nhac
role: The eldest Tay Son brother, founder of the uprising and self-proclaimed emperor ruling the centre from Quy Nhon.
known_facts: Born in 1743, eldest of the three Tay Son brothers.
Led the 1771 uprising at Tay Son in Binh Dinh.
Proclaimed himself Emperor Thai Duc at Quy Nhon in 1778.
Ruled the central region from the Do Ban citadel.
Was angered by Nguyen Hue's northern campaign and marriage made without consulting him.
Marched on Phu Xuan in 1787, then was driven back and besieged at Quy Nhon.
Asked Nguyen Anh for help during the siege.
Kept Quy Nhon under the 1788 partition of the realm.
interpretation: A heavy-set, broad-shouldered man in his mid-forties with a round face, heavy brows and a thick black beard streaked with grey. Black hair in a topknot beneath a black gauze court cap. He wears a yellow brocade imperial robe with dragon roundels and wide sleeves over a dark sash, silk slippers, and at his belt a jade-hilted sword.
